dedupe_keys.name: 災害情報テータヘース disaster risk and hazard maps

description: 災害情報データベース [disaster risk and hazard maps] is a dataset listed in BODIK Open Data Catalogue Service (data.bodik.jp), Japanese local governments, an open data portal, published or maintained by 栃木県. 過去の災害の被災状況等をまとめたデータベース. Coverage: 栃木県. The portal files it under the publisher 栃木県. Its tags are 災害. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2023-04-10 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution 2.1 JP. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-bodik-portal.
